card.name: The word food in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "food" right after "with" or "with or without" in dosing and administration instructions for oral drugs.

modes.label: With or without food
modes.description: Instruction that a tablet or capsule may be taken with or without food.
modes.example: Escitalopram tablets should be administered once daily, in the morning or evening, with or without<< food>>.

modes.label: With food
modes.description: Instruction to give or take the dose together with food.
modes.example: Administer nitrofurantoin oral suspension with<< food>> to improve drug absorption

card.plain: It lights up on the word "food" when a label says how to take a dose relative to meals.
